# 0.23.0 — 6 November 2026

Minor release on 0.22.0. A redesigned `opentide tui`: each object opens as a page with its findings, plus Visibility, Configuration and Chains tabs. The engine is [language-server 0.11.0](https://github.com/opentidehq/language-server/releases/tag/v0.11.0).

## Upgrade

```bash
pip install opentide==0.23.0
export OPENTIDE_REPO_ROOT=/path/to/detection-repo
opentide validate --strict
opentide tui                                         # tabs 4, 5 and 6: Visibility, Configuration, Chains
```

| Before | Now |
|--------|-----|
| `info coverage`, MCP `coverage` and the TUI's Coverage tab counted only a rule's own `techniques`, so a technique a rule takes from its objective or signals showed as a gap (`0 rules`, `covered: false`) | they count own and inherited techniques. `info coverage` adds `own`, `inherited` and `matched_techniques` and prints `3 rules (1 own, 2 inherited)`; MCP `coverage` adds `own_rules`, `inherited_rules` and `own_matrix`. A script that reads `rules` or `covered` sees higher counts and fewer gaps |
| `generate explorer` wrote no visibility data | `generate explorer --include-visibility` also writes `.opentide/exports/explorer.visibility.json`, marked with `--visibility-tlp` (`amber` by default). It is off by default, and a run without the flag removes the file an earlier run wrote |

It is a minor because it adds features (the TUI's object page, findings in place and three tabs, and the visibility export) and changes what `info coverage` and the MCP `coverage` tool count and report.

## Added

- **`opentide tui` shows an object as a page** ([#776](https://github.com/opentidehq/opentide/issues/776)). The detail pane reads the object by its schema revision: a header with version, dates and TLP; an *Overview* and a section per block; vocabulary values with their meaning; the name of each objective, signal or threat a UUID names, which `f` follows; queries in their own panel; and a collapsed *Not set (N)* listing the optional fields it leaves out. `y` shows the file.
- **`opentide tui` shows each finding under its line** ([language-server#215](https://github.com/opentidehq/language-server/issues/215)), with its code, message and help, the gutter marked `✗`, `!` or `·` and its span underlined. Hovering a span shows the editor's hover, and `n` and `p` move between findings. The Python binding has `Workspace.hover(path, text, line, column)`.
- **A Visibility tab in `opentide tui`** ([#776](https://github.com/opentidehq/opentide/issues/776)). Tab `4` lists the log sources `visibility.toml` declares with their system, columns and the rules and objectives that use each, through a query or a signal, and flags log sources without columns, log sources nothing uses, and datasets rules read that no log source declares.
- **A Configuration tab in `opentide tui`** ([#776](https://github.com/opentidehq/opentide/issues/776)). Tab `5` reads each configuration file by section: effective values, whether the workspace sets them, descriptions, findings in place and the options nothing sets. A platform reads as a card with each tenant's strategies, credentials and rules. A credential shows as its variable name and whether it is set, never its value, the raw view (`t`) included.
- **A Chains tab in `opentide tui`** ([#776](https://github.com/opentidehq/opentide/issues/776)). Tab `6` draws `threat.chaining` around the selected threat: sequence links as attack flow, supporting and atomicity links beside them, each threat with its rules and how many of its techniques they cover. `+` and `-` change the hops, `l` the relations, `c` re-centres.
- **`opentide generate explorer --include-visibility` exports visibility for the explorer** ([explorer#85](https://github.com/opentidehq/explorer/issues/85)): each declared log source with its columns and the rules, objectives and signals that use it, the datasets no log source declares, and per-system counts. An inventory of what an organisation can see is sensitive, so the export is opt-in per run.

## Changed

- **The engine is [language-server 0.11.0](https://github.com/opentidehq/language-server/releases/tag/v0.11.0), from crates.io.** The editor and `opentide tui` follow the workspace's `lint.toml` for `filename_slug`, `filename_pattern`, `missing_author` and `missing_organisation`, as `opentide lint` does, and no longer reports a signal's UUID as `invalid_ref`.

## Fixed

- **Coverage counts the techniques a rule inherits** ([#775](https://github.com/opentidehq/opentide/issues/775)). `info coverage`, the MCP `coverage` tool, the TUI's Coverage tab and `info catalog` use one resolver, so they agree; the Coverage tab shows `3  1 own · 2 inherited`.

See the [CHANGELOG](https://github.com/opentidehq/opentide/blob/development/CHANGELOG.md#0230--2026-11-06) for every change.

## Verify

```bash
pip install opentide==0.23.0
python -c "import opentide; print(opentide.__version__)"   # 0.23.0
opentide doctor                                             # analysis_engine: language server 0.11.0
```
